purpose: silver_ourairports_runways is the cleaned, one-row-per-runway view of the OurAirports runways extract landed in bronze.ourairports_runways (10760 rows). It types identifiers and dimensions as numbers, turns the lighted and closed indicators into booleans, drops capture metadata, and feeds airport infrastructure analytics and joins to the airports dimension via airport_ref or airport_ident.
usage: Read one row per runway keyed by id; join to airport records on airport_ref (integer) or airport_ident (text code). Filter deliberately on is_closed_runway or closed when you want only active runways, since closed runways remain in the table. Treat surface as uncontrolled free text (239 distinct values such as 'ASP', 'ASPH-CONC') and bucket it yourself before aggregating, and expect threshold geometry columns to be missing for many rows.
limitations: Cleanup did not normalise surface codes or runway designators: surface carries 239 distinct raw spellings and le_ident/he_ident include non-numeric entries such as '-12', '.' and '-'. Threshold geometry is incomplete, with le_latitude_deg null_rate 0.220911, he_latitude_deg 0.222212, le_elevation_ft 0.276301 and he_elevation_ft 0.276208, and displaced thresholds are nearly empty at 0.884201 and 0.899907. he_heading_degt reaches 362.0, which exceeds a valid compass range and was retained unmodified; length_ft includes a minimum of 0.0 that may be a placeholder rather than a measured length. No values were imputed and no rows were removed, since duplicate_row_rate is 0.0.
